summary: Fix 1: Relaxed the IN_PROGRESS guard in begin-work.ts — now accepts both the current assignee and the legitimate pipeline-type owner (PIPELINE_AGENT_MAP[type] === agent_role) instead of assignee-only. Resolves cross-agent handoff failures when using ledger_begin_work.

Fix 2: Added optional preloadedWpDetails parameter to getProjectManagerAction (matching pattern of getDeveloperAction/getQaAction/getReviewerAction/getDocumentationAction); updated the switch call site to pass the top-level pre-loaded wpDetails, eliminating the redundant internal Promise.all fetch.
Fix 3: Extracted getSynthesisAction() named helper from the inline object literal in the Synthesis switch case, matching the style of all other agent-role helpers.

Tests: Added 3 new cross-agent handoff tests (QA←Developer-assigned WP, Reviewer←QA-assigned WP, Documentation←Reviewer-assigned WP); narrowed existing rejection test to require both assignment-guard and pipeline-owner-guard to fail simultaneously. All 986 tests pass (983 original + 3 new).

summary: All three fixes pass review across all four dimensions (Maintainability, Best Practices, Security/Performance, Future Context). No blocking issues found.

Fix 1: guard logic is minimal, spec-compliant, and correctly scoped. Compound check avoids false rejections while preserving all existing security boundaries. Defence-in-depth via the pipeline-start PIPELINE_AGENT_MAP validation below the gate.
Fix 2: preloadedWpDetails optional param follows the established pattern of all other getXxxAction helpers. null-coalescing fallback ensures backward compatibility for isolated callers.
Fix 3: getSynthesisAction() is correctly synchronous — the only action helper that doesn't perform I/O. Switch case handles the sync return with no spurious await.

comments.note: Fix 1 — guard logic is minimal and correct. The compound check (wp.assigned_to !== agent_role && !isPipelineOwner) is the smallest spec-compliant change. The inline comment referencing §9.1/§16.5 is an excellent addition. The pipeline-start phase's own PIPELINE_AGENT_MAP validation provides defence-in-depth after the IN_PROGRESS gate, so there is no security regression.

Fix 1 — test coverage is precise. The three cross-agent handoff tests each assert claimed:false, pipeline IN_PROGRESS, AND assigned_to updated to the new agent — confirming the pipeline-start phase auto-update ran correctly. The rejection test requires BOTH guards to fail simultaneously (Developer attempting a qa pipeline on a QA-assigned WP), preventing false-positive passes.

Fix 2 — preloadedWpDetails ?? await Promise.all(...) null-coalescing is idiomatic and safe. The fallback path ensures the function still works when called in isolation (e.g., from tests), while the happy path eliminates N extra disk reads per PM-role call to get_next_action. No behavioral change.

Fix 3 — getSynthesisAction() is correctly synchronous (no async/await needed). All other agent-role helpers are async because they perform I/O; Synthesis is intentionally sync. The switch case handles this correctly with no spurious await. Style-consistency improvement with the correct technical choice.

Gold Nugget: the review process itself provided a live meta-validation of Fix 1. The Reviewer agent was blocked by the exact bug under review (old error: 'Only the assigned agent...'), then unblocked after killing the stale MCP server process, and ledger_begin_work succeeded on the first retry — the strongest possible integration test of the fix.
